title: Blush Framework entry
description: An entry's front matter: the fields every entry understands. Content types and relations add their own.

subtitle.description: Subtitle: A line shown under the title.

slug.description: Slug: The URL name, instead of the file name.

date.description: Date: The entry's date, such as 2026-09-26 09:00:00 -05:00. A date in the future schedules the entry.

expires.description: Expires: When the entry comes off the site, in a type with expiry, such as 2026-12-31 23:59:00 -05:00. Moving or clearing it brings the entry back.

updated.description: Updated: When it last changed; defaults to the date, then the file's modified time.

status.description: Status: published (the default), draft, trash, or another status the site registers.

trashed.description: Trashed: When the entry was moved to the trash, set with status: trash.

visibility.description: Visibility: public (the default), unlisted, or hidden.

summary.description: Summary: A short Markdown summary for listings and feeds. Without one, the first 50 words are used.

excerpt.description: Same as summary. A short Markdown summary for listings and feeds. Without one, the first 50 words are used.

template.description: Template: The theme template to use, such as single-wide.

view.description: Same as template. The theme template to use, such as single-wide.

stylesheet.description: Stylesheet: An extra stylesheet for this page.

class.description: Classes: Extra CSS classes for the page's <body>, separated by spaces.

translation_of.description: Original: For a translation, the id of the entry it translates, which links them whatever their file names.

collection.description: Collection: Lists other entries on this page.

id.description: The entry's id, a UUID, kept last. Blush writes it; content:ids adds a missing one.

refs.description: The ids of the entries this one links to, by relation, then by the slug written for each. Blush writes it beside the slugs.
